svg.title: Initial Core v0 deployment with one configured Vault and a future multi-vault seam
svg.desc: Engineer Windows computers run a browser, WPF WebView2 Desktop, per-user Workspace and external engineering tools. One Ubuntu Server virtual machine runs Nginx, Temurin, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL. Large file bytes bypass this Server and move through one configured Artifact Gateway to Vault location A. A dashed future location shows the extension seam only; it is not deployed in Core v0. A separate backup target protects database, Artifact, configuration, policy and key recovery sets. The single Server is not highly available.
